% A part's entry in the table of contents of a report: the space above it
% from report's \l@part (\addvspace{2.25em plus 1pt}), and below it only
% the next chapter's space.
\documentclass{report}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{First}
Some text.
\part{Beginnings}
\chapter{After the part}
Some text.
\end{document}
